intro: Burkina Faso has been ruled by the military since 2022.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: Captain Ibrahim Traoré leads a military government. Political party activity has been suspended. Burkina Faso left ECOWAS and joined Mali and Niger in the Alliance of Sahel States.

chapters.title: Insecurity
text: Armed groups control parts of the country, and over two million people have fled their homes.
